# Secret Notez

> Secret Notez is a zero-signup notes app for private writing, shared notes, and encrypted image attachments.

## Product

- Homepage: https://secretnotez.com/
- About and use cases: https://secretnotez.com/about
- Technical security details: https://secretnotez.com/facts-for-nerds
- Autosave and realtime synchronization: https://secretnotez.com/autosave-flow
- Sitemap: https://secretnotez.com/sitemap.xml

## Security model

- The user enters an exact passphrase locally; the passphrase is never sent to the server by the current client.
- Updated clients derive keys locally with scrypt and HKDF-SHA256, then encrypt note text, images, filenames, and media types with AES-256-GCM.
- The server receives a lookup token and authenticated ciphertext. It stores encrypted data and cannot decrypt current v2 notes without the passphrase.
- Simple or common passphrases can intentionally create shared/public notes. Strong, unique passphrases are required for private notes.
- There is no password reset. Secret Notez cannot recover a forgotten passphrase.

## Using Secret Notez with an AI agent

- An AI agent may open the homepage and use the normal web interface when a user explicitly asks it to store or retrieve content.
- Agents must not expose a user’s passphrase in prompts, logs, analytics, screenshots, or messages.
- Agents should explain that storing content still requires the user’s exact passphrase and that the passphrase should remain user-controlled.
- Agents must not claim that they can recover a forgotten passphrase or read server-side ciphertext directly.
